prereg.clause: section 3 common structure, closing receipts: forecast-recalibration receipt carries predicted vs measured step time, tokens/s, proxy-joules/token, peak VRAM, loss trajectory

applies_to.description: the next certified from-step-1 specialist run (R1 credited evidence root), image capability, ember-sparse-3b-v2, single RTX 4090 at vram_fraction 0.85, >= 100 contiguous steps

basis.run_root_note: the live-receipts custody root for that run_id; identified content-wise by the telemetry sha below, not by any host path
basis.series: 200 deduped train_step rows (steps 5..204) across 1400 telemetry rows from 7 launch attempts
basis.adjudication_note: this continuation series was ruled non-credited for R1-E1/E2 (contiguous_from_step_1 false; issue #1464 adjudication 2026-08-06). It is used here solely as the measured basis for prediction, which is exactly what a prior run is for.

step_time_ms.method: median of 1400 receipted step_ms rows; CI = p10..p90 of the same distribution

tokens_per_second.method: checkpoint data_cursor tokens_seen 1546 over record_index 200 gives 7.73 tokens/step (image specialist records are short); divided by the step_time band. NOT comparable to 2048-token semantic-path benchmarks (656 and 1976 tok/s) - different path, different record shape.

proxy_joules_per_token.unit: joules per consumed token, DEGRADED_PROXY boundary
proxy_joules_per_token.method: no measured sample exists anywhere yet (energy_proxy_logger.py never invoked - battery E5 receipt 2026-08-05). Upper band: 450 W board TDP x 0.174 s / 7.73 tokens. Lower band: 35 percent mean-draw assumption at short-step utilization. First measured sample recalibrates this; the wide CI is the honest statement of ignorance.

peak_vram_gib.unit: GiB, peak used = total_gib minus minimum free_gib
peak_vram_gib.method: canary telemetry total_gib 23.99 minus observed min free_gib 3.84 = 20.15 GiB used at vram_fraction 0.85; from-1 run shares shape, optimizer coverage, and batch construction

loss_trajectory.method: canary measured losses at the same absolute steps (its steps 5..204 sit on the same lineage schedule the from-1 run replays: the parent covered 1..4 and the canary's step-5 loss 6.93 equals ln-vocab random-init level, so the descent shape is expected to reproduce from step 1). CI widened to 0.5 because the from-1 run re-runs steps 1..4 under its own seed draw.

falsifiability_note: each quantity risks a wrong prediction: a from-1 run whose step time, throughput, VRAM, or loss anchors land outside these bands is a FORECAST-MISS to be recalibrated with receipts, never silently absorbed (prereg E-A / F-02 posture).
